items.name: Copper
items.notes: Rendered pages confirm API keys (self-generated in System settings) and OAuth2.0 (preferred for partner integrations). The earlier note that OAuth client registration goes through partners@copper.com was not re-checked in the rendered pages. The official Copper MCP is not live: copper.com/mcp says the beta launches in November 2026, read-only, with a waitlist. Copper GPT (ChatGPT) exists separately. Which plans include API access is unclear. Copper works only with Gmail and Google Workspace.

items.name: Jira
items.notes: Browser pass confirmed self-serve access: Free plan and trials need no sales contact, and OAuth apps are created in the developer console. Basic is dropped as a separate method because the Basic header only carries email + API token (api_key). JWT applies to Connect apps. Atlassian policy says apps that collect API tokens or ask customers to make their own 3LO apps violate its policy; distributable apps should use one 3LO app. Rovo MCP API-token auth needs org admin enablement, and some Rovo tools use credits. Pricing page notes usage-based billing starting Dec 3, 2026. Data Center is not covered. Admin requirement for app install not shown.
